description: This PHP class 'TimesheetActionLogDecorator' serves as a decorator around the 'TimesheetActionLog' entity, providing methods to access formatted date, action label, and to associate a user with the log entry. It utilizes traits for common functionality and is part of the OrangeHRM system's Entity decorator namespace.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class providing formatted accessors and utility methods for the TimesheetActionLog entity in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a TimesheetActionLog entity.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the log date formatted as 'Y-m-d' string.

methods.name: getActionLabel
methods.description: Returns the action label with proper capitalization.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Associates a user (by ID) with the action log using a reference.
